purpose: Evidence pack for the second bounded manual review batch. These are proposed relevance decisions only and do not alter the terminal IGOD assessment state or authorize publication.

rows.authorityName: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DoAFW)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund guideline: eligible post-harvest and community-farming-asset projects, lender route, interest subvention, and project conditions
rows.rationale: The department publishes agriculture infrastructure finance and implementation routes relevant to agri-entrepreneurs, startups, farmer groups, and infrastructure businesses.

rows.authorityName: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DoAHD)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Revised National Livestock Mission guideline: component-specific capital subsidy, eligible entities, State Implementing Agency route, and project verification
rows.rationale: The department publishes livestock, poultry, sheep/goat, feed, and entrepreneurship-support routes that directly affect eligible businesses and project operators.

rows.evidenceAnchor: BIRAC SBIRI: biotech company/LLP proposal route, recurring calls, technical evaluation, and milestone-linked grant support
rows.rationale: DBT-linked BIRAC programmes provide biotech R&D, incubation, proof-of-concept, and commercialisation routes for science-led companies and institutions.

rows.evidenceAnchor: NIDHI schemes and programmes index, including Seed Support, Entrepreneur-in-Residence, PRAYAS, and incubation routes
rows.rationale: DST publishes entrepreneurship, incubation, prototype, seed-support, and technology-commercialisation programmes for innovators and startups.

rows.evidenceAnchor: PRIP scheme page: pharma/medtech research, innovation, priority areas, CoE and startup/MSME routes
rows.rationale: The department publishes pharmaceutical and medical-device R&D, innovation, manufacturing, and infrastructure-support routes for businesses and institutions.

rows.evidenceAnchor: DCIS FAQ and linked DoT route for telecom startups/MSMEs, testing/certification reimbursement, and application conditions
rows.rationale: DoT publishes telecom testing, certification, innovation, production, and startup/MSME support routes relevant to communications businesses.

rows.evidenceAnchor: Scheme for Promotion of MSMEs in Defence: defence supply-chain market access, conclaves, workshops, and eligible event-agency sponsorship route
rows.rationale: DDP publishes defence-industrial participation, MSME supply-chain, innovation, procurement, and event-support routes.

rows.authorityName: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
rows.evidenceAnchor: Environmental Impact Assessment overview: online application, appraisal, clearance workflow, and project-level compliance conditions
rows.rationale: MoEFCC controls environmental-clearance and compliance workflows that businesses must understand before starting or expanding regulated projects.
